aboutText: Hillel Bezek’s work explores the space between fragmentation and unity, absence and wholeness. Drawing on Jewish and Israeli traditions, as well as broader histories and cultures, his practice engages with themes of identity, memory, and resilience. Through painting, drawing, and mixed media, he creates visual narratives that invite contemplation and dialogue.
